label: S8-M1-yes-never-promotes
why: Maps a valid `yes` to `unjudged`, which is exactly the judge that satisfies every failure-path row and promotes nothing. The whole reason the success half exists is that this mutant is invisible to a suite of failure paths alone.
old:
parsed = parse_judge_result(raw)
        if parsed is not None:
new:
parsed = parse_judge_result(raw)
        if parsed is not None and parsed != JUDGE_YES:

label: S8-M2-promotion-counts-findings
why: Counts promoted FINDINGS rather than promoting the CASE, which is the per-finding reading of §3.1.1. It passes the single-`yes` row and must be killed by the second-`yes` row.

label: S8-M3-retries-unbounded
why: Raises the retry ceiling. A judge that retries without a bound turns a dead launcher into a hang rather than into an `unjudged`.

label: S8-M4-catch-is-re-judged
why: Drops the refusal that keeps `catch` and `miss` off the judging path. §3.9 decides those four mechanically so the grade does not drift when the judge changes; a judgement silently applied to a catch is a judge that CAN move a mechanical verdict.

label: S8-M5-model-may-say-unjudged
why: Lets the model return the harness's own failure word. A model declining and a launcher failing are two different facts, and one spelling records them as the same one.
